name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Leaf.leafKey_apply_some
title: Leaf key by box rejection: its law is explicit and independent of the trapdoor
statement: For a preimage of u under [B | A] sampled by one try of box rejection (boxSample) with public map x -> B x, decomposition y -> dec(-y) (G dec(y) = y) and any trapdoor T with B T(z) = (A + G) z covered by the boxes (Small + T(dec(-y)) inside Big): an output (x, z) has probability 1/|Big| if x is in Small, z is a decomposition and B x + A z = u, and 0 otherwise.
